name: Hot Pixel Removal and Sensor Cleaning
description:
An astronomical image of a galaxy has been corrupted by 'hot pixels' (sensor defects appearing as single pure-white pixels). Your task is to clean this image while preserving the scientific data (stars and galaxy structure).

1. Open the noisy image located at: ~/ImageJ_Data/raw/noisy_galaxy.tif
2. Identify the hot pixels (single pixels with value 65535).
3. Use the 'Remove Outliers' filter (Process > Noise > Remove Outliers) to eliminate these artifacts. You must choose parameters (Radius and Threshold) that remove the single-pixel noise without blurring the stars or the galaxy details.
4. Save the cleaned 16-bit image to: ~/ImageJ_Data/results/clean_galaxy.tif

Note: A simple Gaussian Blur is NOT acceptable as it destroys data resolution.
